title: Comelec receives 99.29% of BARMM election returns as of Tuesday night (Sept. 15, 2026)
summary: The Commission on Elections has received 99.29% of the election returns in the first Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao elections.

blocks.text: The Commission on Elections has received 99.29% of the election returns in the first Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao elections.
As of 10:33 p.m. on Tuesday, the Comelec dashboard showed that the election body has received 5,175 ERs out of the 5,212 expected.
It has received all of the 108 certificates of canvass from the cities and municipalities.
Only one provincial or district COC out of six has yet to be received. –NB, GMA News
